body: S3 #4362 final items pushed at 81cbe3ada1c, one commit (the three items only). F1: two-seat-protocol.md template master (synced; check-templates OK) gains a Landing modes section (both modes, when to choose each, red-main watch as scheduled `land watch` only); condition 3 and the merge-train/behind-main wording are now mode-conditional; docs/advanced/landing.md intro no longer says every PR goes through a train and says when to choose ci-gated. F2: `aida land watch` prints main_watch::status_line from the state file (red/confirmed/waiting with fix spec); never green while an episode is open; regression a_steady_confirmed_red_never_reports_green. F3: landing_policy::duration_text (90s -> 1m30s) used by config show; round-trip test. main_watch 45/45, story_1418_completion_seam 14/14, check-ci-fast exit 0; ci:full relabelled.
